remarks: Welcome to Piper, Norwalk's newest luxury community. This new-construction, two-story townhouse offers 2 bedrooms, a den, a loft, and 3 baths, with two entry points: direct access from the garage and a private street-level entrance. The open first floor features a kitchen with quartz counters, tile backsplash, stainless appliances, and large windows. Upstairs, 2 bedrooms, den and a loft, generous closets, and soaking tub. In-unit washer/dryer, keyless entry, and smart thermostat included. Amenities include: resort-style pool, firepits and grills, rooftop deck, fitness center and studio, wine room, resident lounges, private on-site work offices, pet spa, and indoor pet play area. Next door to restaurants, coffee shops and Mathews Park, and minutes to SoNo dining and nightlife, the Maritime Aquarium, Wall Street Theater, Norwalk Art Space. Metro-North and I-95 nearby for Stamford, New Haven, and NYC; close to Westport, New Canaan, and Fairfield. A great fit if you're looking for a lovely home without outdoor upkeep, relocating, between homes, or renovating. Special Offer: 2 months free rent if move in occurs within 60 days of applying.
